readerCopy.body: Missing what was familiar can make returning look more right than it is when the newer arrangement still feels unsettled. When the Moon opposes the North Node, familiar comfort and forward movement face each other directly, making an old home, routine, relationship pattern, or schedule emotionally convincing because the body already knows how to live inside it. The pull can contain useful information about rest, belonging, predictability, or care. The need can be brought forward without rebuilding the entire old arrangement around it.
